scripts.build: bun run check && bun --bun vite build
scripts.test:e2e:install: node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install --only-shell chromium firefox webkit
scripts.format: bun --bun prettier --write src tests e2e flashwright.config.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: bun --bun prettier --check src tests e2e flashwright.config.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html .prettierrc.json
